consensual 
sexual relationship with a reptilian by the name of 
Hamish, whom from what I can tell like most human men hangs around, doesn't like to have a job, does nothing, and demands sex all the time.,. and whom she develops a substantial romantic relationship with, describing his psychology, 
his... anatomy... and the psychology of other reptilians and other aliens, their evolution, their history, and other such things at great length. I suppose we all have 
kinks.

The art itself is not consistent and she redraws them repeatedly over time - and there's substantial indication that the Orions themselves didn't want themselves to be seen in such a manner. In any case, Eva has had obviously some degree of scientific mindset as - despite the oddity of the situation - she does take great care to accurately and scientifically give a huge wealth of invaluable information about the interstellar medium and the aliens that visit here, which include Nordic aliens and others not commonly associated with the Orion Empire. The vast majority of the beings she encounters that are reptilian are definitely Orion Reptilians - with some description of the Alpha Draconians whom he does not meet directly - but she herself rarely paints any of them in a good or fair light - with a rather... strange exception.My thoughts exactly.What is most shocking isn't the notable, obvious mental illness of Eva (despite her occasionally rational, scientific perspective of the admittedly strange situation), but that she at extreme length takes great detail to describe... most strangely her consensual sexual relationship with a reptilian by the name of Hamish, whom from what I can tell like most human men hangs around, doesn't like to have a job, does nothing, and demands sex all the time.,. and whom she develops a substantial romantic relationship with, describing his psychology, his... anatomy... and the psychology of other reptilians and other aliens, their evolution, their history, and other such things at great length. I suppose we all have kinks.Regardless of that, it's an incredible source of information, and a massively helpful contribution. Even then, what's clear is that the rest of the interstellar community is very obviously working together with the Orlons such to my knowledge the substantial demonization of them isn't justified.But to be fair - as hilarious, interesting, and informative as this website is, scoring a human woman like this probably wasn't intended by the Orions, and in all likelihood from my understanding this subject, "Hamish" I'm going to assume was likely punished extensively for doing this, to the point that I have heard other sources outright call him a "crackhead", and beyond that I have no need to elaborate any further.The website itself is (not surprisingly) down these days, no doubt because at least the information was highly controversial, but archives exist on the web.Community content is available under CC-BY-SA unless otherwise noted.EXPLORE PROPERTIESFandomFanaticalGameSpotMetacriticTV GuideHonest EntertainmentFOLLOW USOVERVIEWWhat is Fandom?AboutCareersPressContactTerms of UsePrivacy PolicyDigital Services ActGlobal SitemapLocal SitemapCOMMUNITYCommunity CentralSupportHelpADVERTISEMedia KitContactFANDOM APPSTake your favorite fandoms with you and never miss a beat.New-Disclosure-Encyclopedia Wiki is a Fandom Lifestyle Community.VIEW MOBILE SITE

scientifically give a huge wealth of invaluable information about the interstellar medium and the aliens that visit here, which include 
Nordic aliens and others not commonly associated with the 
Orion Empire. The vast majority of the beings she encounters that are reptilian are definitely

Alpha Draconians whom he does not meet directly - but she herself rarely paints any of them in a good or fair light - with a rather... strange exception.

consensual

his... anatomy... and the psychology of other reptilians and other aliens, their evolution, their history, and other such things at great length. I suppose we all have

The art itself is not consistent and she redraws them repeatedly over time - and there's substantial indication that the Orions themselves didn't want themselves to be seen in such a manner. In any case, Eva has had obviously some degree of scientific mindset as - despite the oddity of the situation - she does take great care to accurately and 
scientifically give a huge wealth of invaluable information about the interstellar medium and the aliens that visit here, which include 
Nordic aliens and others not commonly associated with the 
Orion Empire. The vast majority of the beings she encounters that are reptilian are definitely 
Orion Reptilians - with some description of the 
Alpha Draconians whom he does not meet directly - but she herself rarely paints any of them in a good or fair light - with a rather... strange exception. 
My thoughts exactly.
What is most shocking isn't the notable, obvious mental illness of Eva (despite her occasionally rational, scientific perspective of the admittedly strange situation), but that she at extreme length takes great detail to describe... most strangely her 
consensual 
sexual relationship with a reptilian by the name of 
Hamish, whom from what I can tell like most human men hangs around, doesn't like to have a job, does nothing, and demands sex all the time.,. and whom she develops a substantial romantic relationship with, describing his psychology, 
his... anatomy... and the psychology of other reptilians and other aliens, their evolution, their history, and other such things at great length. I suppose we all have 
kinks.

The art itself is not consistent and she redraws them repeatedly over time - and there's substantial indication that the Orions themselves didn't want themselves to be seen in such a manner. In any case, Eva has had obviously some degree of scientific mindset as - despite the oddity of the situation - she does take great care to accurately and 
scientifically give a huge wealth of invaluable information about the interstellar medium and the aliens that visit here, which include 
Nordic aliens and others not commonly associated with the 
Orion Empire. The vast majority of the beings she encounters that are reptilian are definitely 
Orion Reptilians - with some description of the 
Alpha Draconians whom he does not meet directly - but she herself rarely paints any of them in a good or fair light - with a rather... strange exception. 
My thoughts exactly.

consensual 
sexual relationship with a reptilian by the name of 
Hamish, whom from what I can tell like most human men hangs around, doesn't like to have a job, does nothing, and demands sex all the time.,. and whom she develops a substantial romantic relationship with, describing his psychology, 
his... anatomy... and the psychology of other reptilians and other aliens, their evolution, their history, and other such things at great length. I suppose we all have 
kinks.

his... anatomy... and the psychology of other reptilians and other aliens, their evolution, their history, and other such things at great length. I suppose we all have

Orion Reptilians abducting her and utilizing her eggs to create hybrid creatures - of which she also details a substantial amount of information about the interstellar medium, the Orions and even the Alpha Draconians, including self-drawn pictures that at worst look like the drawings of someone who clearly who had no art background, to at other times someone drawing fan-made versions of the Covenant aliens from Halo using basic Photoshop. The art itself is not consistent and she redraws them repeatedly over time - and there's substantial indication that the Orions themselves didn't want themselves to be seen in such a manner. In any case, Eva has had obviously some degree of scientific mindset as - despite the oddity of the situation - she does take great care to accurately and 
scientifically give a huge wealth of invaluable information about the interstellar medium and the aliens that visit here, which include 
Nordic aliens and others not commonly associated with the 
Orion Empire. The vast majority of the beings she encounters that are reptilian are definitely 
Orion Reptilians - with some description of the 
Alpha Draconians whom he does not meet directly - but she herself rarely paints any of them in a good or fair light - with a rather... strange exception. 
My thoughts exactly.
What is most shocking isn't the notable, obvious mental illness of Eva (despite her occasionally rational, scientific perspective of the admittedly strange situation), but that she at extreme length takes great detail to describe... most strangely her 
consensual 
sexual relationship with a reptilian by the name of 
Hamish, whom from what I can tell like most human men hangs around, doesn't like to have a job, does nothing, and demands sex all the time.,. and whom she develops a substantial romantic relationship with, describing his psychology, 
his... anatomy... and the psychology of other reptilians and other aliens, their evolution, their history, and other such things at great length. I suppose we all have 
kinks.

So the Alpha Reticulans have a written language consisting of geometrical shapes, such as circles, lines, curves, and dots. Their writing is picture-based, meaning that many of their written symbols resemble the actual shape of the thing that they are describing, almost as if the symbols were based on a drawing of what they mean. Planets and stars start out as circles, with modifications consisting of lines or dots. A notable common feature is the horisontal line, which can denote the ground or surface of a planet, to say that someone owns a planet or land, or that something took place on a planet or land, the horisontal line is drawn there as a ground. This is all very basic and direct based on the appearance of things, and is very simple or we should say also primitive writing. Another common feature are the vessels or bowls, which are made as U-shapes that can be either facing with the opening up or to the side. This denotes either an actual container of sorts, or it can also denote any object or item into which something is placed, even the bodysuit that a Reticulan wears as clothes is thus a vessel or a container denoted in part by the bowl symbol. Light and radiation, be it the light that enters into an eye that sees, the radiation emitted by a star naturally, or the radiation emitted because of a nuclear power accident, are drawn as lines as a radiance.
